note: Wooded campground on Tamarack Ln near Springwater (Livingston Co), south of Hemlock and Canadice Lakes; RV and tent sites, cabins, pool and mini golf. Mostly seasonal: of about 200 trailer sites, 12 are sold by the night. Google 4.2 over 193 reviews. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40 ($50 holiday weekends) from the rates page and a June 2027 RoverPass cart, RoverPass booking (12 months ahead), season May 2-Oct 19 from the engine, 30/50-amp + water but no sewer at the nightly sites, 12 nightly back-in sites of about 200.
flags: Long-stay test 4: the operator advertises '200 spacious trailer sites' and its RoverPass engine sells 12 nightly RV sites (sites 255-258, 263-266, 280-283; 12 available on both June 2027 test dates), about 6% of the park; the rest are not sold nightly online (presumably seasonal). Under 1 site in 10 nightly would fail test 4 if the 200 count is the denominator.
Phone: the website and entry give 585-669-2252; the RoverPass park record and check-in instructions give the store at (585) 516-5911.
